name: v6-gate
description: Flow 3's false alarms: clean sedans in five colours on the gate under six suns, photographed as the plant scene does (fixed gate cameras, loop running; scripts/capture_gate_set.py, 2026-10-10). Every car is undamaged, so any finding is a false alarm. Ten cases give the same frames a build sheet with the wrong colour, which must still be caught. Three more are Qais's multi-car plant cars, photographed after driving onto the mark. Each case has a reference: a different clean car photographed by the same cameras in the same light (the next colour, or another plant car), which findings are checked against.
